QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] What Parma Knows
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart feels something is not quite right about everything that happened in Kritias. He asks you to investigate Kritias to find out the truth of that day once more.
QuestInfo.1: You met Head Maid Parma while searching for the missing king. She didn't know the details of the king's whereabouts. It seems he had a secret destination. Parma said Hirrel the clerk should know more.
QuestInfo.2: You met Head Maid Parma. She said Hirrel the clerk should know more.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  52,303,300
Can proceed to [Kritias] What Hirrel Knows

0.0: I don't know where His Majesty is. I'm not hiding anything. I really don't know. His Majesty was traveling somewhere earlier that day, and when the tragedy happened, he evacuated us all and disappeared.\r\n#L0# #bWhere did he travel?#l\n#k
0.1: ...I'm not sure about that. He traveled as usual with a very small entourage. \r\n#L0# #bHe traveled as usual but you don't know? #l\n#k
0.2: That's correct. On the day of His Majesty's travel, no one is allowed to ask about the destination. Only a very few know about it.\r\n#L0# #bIs there anyone who still knows?#l\n#k
0.3: ...There is just one person who is still alive. Hirrel the clerk knows His Majesty's travel location.

yes.0: Hirrel is a capable administrator. If general Blundell is the sword of His Majesty, then Hirrel is the hand. There is nothing that His Majesty has done that has not passed through his hands.
yes.1: Just in case, His Majesty's disappearance is entirely unrelated to this. He was a compassionte and wise king. The only reason we are alive is because His Majesty evacuated us.
yes.2: Of course, there was frequent talk about eternal life and immortality lately... But it shouldn't be surprising, since His Majesty is an old man now, right?
yes.3: Anyway, go see Hirrel the clerk if you have more questions. I don't know any more than this.

1.0: Are you talking about His Majesty Hekaton's travel location? Hm...

yes.0: The king's destination is a national secret but... it might be unavoidable in these circumstances.

default.0: Hirrel is in front of the Town Hall. Go see him.
